changelog: **Adding a locale is one command, and hand-written locale lists are a ratchet (#2082, slice 2):** `npm run i18n:import -- <file> --create` builds a new locale's block from a complete, reviewed translation file (the English block with every literal replaced, so `Dict` type-checks it), adds it to `dictionaries` and to `locales` in `src/i18n/config.ts`, and refuses any MISSING/MT string or changed placeholder. `npm run check:locale-list` (CI) fails on a new hand-written `['en', 'tr', 'de']` / `'en' | 'tr' | 'de'` outside config.ts; the 36 older copies are pinned in `scripts/locale-list-baseline.json` and only shrink. `PUT /api/profile` (`preferredLanguage`) and `POST /api/mentor-applications` now validate against `locales` and the document review label reads `isLocale()`, so a new language is not refused there. `docs/i18n.md` records what a fourth locale costs today: 755 type errors in 34 files, 636 of them the release-note history.
